grass_base.description: Dark lush green grass ground tile with subtle blade texture. 3-4 shades: #1E3020 base, #2A4A2C mid, #3B5E3A highlights. Occasional tiny wildflower dots. Must tile seamlessly. High top-down pixel art, no outline on edges.

grass_path.description: Worn dirt path tile cutting through dark green grass. Brown (#3B2E1A) packed earth center with grass fringe on edges. Must tile seamlessly in path direction and transition to grass_base on sides.
